dkan_dataset/a217613c-12bc-5137-8b3a-ada.title: NADAC Comparison
dkan_dataset/a217613c-12bc-5137-8b3a-ada.description:
The NADAC Weekly Comparison identifies the drug products with current NADAC rates that are replaced with new NADAC rates.  Other changes (e.g. NDC additions and terminations) to the NADAC file are not reflected in this comparison.

Note: Effective Date was not recorded in the dataset until 6/7/2017

dkan_dataset/e3af839d-8175-5be0-b94e-4a3.description: The tables below display new National Average Drug Acquisition Cost (NADAC) rates, sorted by Drug Product and Date. The drug products listed have not had a NADAC rate in the past.
